title: Medtrum : PasswordReset doesn't work
symptom: After force closing AAPS and creating a PasswordReset file in aaps/extra, starting AAPS and entering the pump base serial in config wizard results in 'wrong password'. The file stays on dev but gets deleted on master.
cause: The password reset file content was being read as uppercase, but the expected format is lowercase.
fix: The fix is to use lowercase in the PasswordReset file. A commit was made to make it uppercase, which is more expectable, but the immediate workaround is to write the file in lowercase.
evidence_quote: it should work. It's in lowercase
